security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Radiotherapy treatment planning for student training
bundle.longDescription: PlanLab is a teaching treatment planning system: import CT (DICOM), contour targets and organs at risk, place and shape beams (jaws, MLC, wedges), calculate 3D dose and evaluate DVHs against tolerance doses. Not for clinical use.
